title: The Decline of Non-Military Montepíos in Early Mexico: A Historical, Actuarial, and Financial Approach
abstract: A historical and actuarial analysis of early Mexican non-military pension funds links their decline to institutional design and financial imbalances, including contribution periods, survivor benefits, and household and marriage patterns.
venue: Journal of Management and Financial Sciences
abstract_es: Un análisis histórico y actuarial de los primeros fondos de pensiones no militares de México vincula su declive con el diseño institucional y los desequilibrios financieros, incluidos los periodos de cotización, las pensiones de sobrevivencia y los patrones familiares y matrimoniales.
